text: Too many guys make this mistake. They fall in love with a girl who barely knows their name. Maybe she's the pretty girl at the gym. Maybe you matched on Tinder and had one coffee. Maybe you even hooked up once. And suddenly, in your head, she is the one. Don't put her on a pedestal. That's not love. That's fantasy. You don't even know her yet. You haven't seen her values, how she treats people, how she acts when things get tough. All you have seen is the highlight reel. When you rush in, when you put her above yourself, you turn into an easy-to-get man. You're basically saying, any woman who gives me a little bit of attention instantly becomes my dream girl. That shows inexperience and lack of standards. Don't put her on a pedestal. Real strength is slowing down and reminding yourself, she has to qualify for me too. Attraction should be mutual. Respect should be mutual. A real relationship takes time, consistency, and shared values. Change the script. You don't make her the prize just because she smiled at you. Make her earn a place in your life, just like you earn a place in hers.
